title: Book Three · Chapter 100: Two Books Back
story:
On Monday, Mr Qiu gives Ronan a short note.

Mr Wei brought it yesterday. Two of the six gift books have missing pages. He wants to return them.

Ronan reads the address, then shows the note to Leo.

“The last two,” he says quietly.

Leo looks at the stock bags. “We need to see them.”

Mr Wei is at home that afternoon. His house is across town. The two local bus rides will cost two yuan together.

The boys agree to pay that from the shared money. The two returned books will need four yuan in refunds.

Ronan takes six yuan from their shared cash. He leaves forty-three in the envelope and puts the six in a separate pocket.

Leo writes what the money is for. He will check the remaining books while Ronan goes.

At Mr Wei's home, the man brings out one story and one travel book. Both have B inside the back cover.

Both came from the last eight they bought. Both were in the unchecked pair.

The story has lost its last pages. The travel book has two maps cut out. Mr Wei shows the empty edges.

“They were gifts,” he says.

Ronan looks at the bright covers. They are still bright.

“I promised to check,” he says. “I didn't finish these.”

“You said they would be complete.”

“Yes. I'm sorry.”

Ronan gives back four yuan. Mr Wei gives him both books. The other four books from the order are staying with the family.

Ronan takes the damaged pair home in one shared cloth bag. The return bus uses the last coin from the six.

At the table, he lays out the two books and the empty pocket.

“Four back to him. Two for both rides.”

Leo checks the line he wrote. Then they count the envelope together.

Forty-three yuan. No money has gone into either boy's personal pocket.

There are eleven books in the room now. The nine left from Saturday are still there. The two returned B books are beside them.

Ronan puts the damaged books in a separate pile. He writes Missing Pages on a small sheet and lays it on top.

“Not for the table,” he says.

Leo nods. He has checked four of the nine good books so far. He takes another and turns to its first page.

Ronan sits beside him with the next one. For a while, they work quietly. Outside, people stop for pencils and walk away.

The large book-sale card is folded beneath the cloth bags. Neither boy takes it back to the gate.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

refund＝退款；damaged＝有损坏的；shared money＝共同的钱；separate pile＝单独的一摞。

## 理解问题

1. 哪两本书退回，来源是什么？顾客共拿回多少钱？
2. 往返公交费由谁同意、从哪里支付？最后共同现金和实体书各是多少？

## 读句子

**Ronan puts the damaged books in a separate pile.**

拆开看：Ronan / puts the damaged books / in a separate pile.

Ronan／把有损坏的书放好／单独放成一摞。
